_spec: SNG-644 — staged (reader before field: C18). A seat held by the savior side: a challenger's finish cannot promote it while the holder stands. Holder removed (slain, turned, or broken) → the seat opens to whichever challenger did it.

heldSeats.holdsBy: She has buried more than she has known and did not stop attending: she refuses neither the dying nor the living.
heldSeats.knows: what she is holding back — not that it is a seat
heldSeats.ifBeaten: the challenger who beat her may finish, and a finish is a seat

heldSeats.holdsBy: She unmakes only what should end, and stops. Restraint in the breaking half, which is the rarer one.
heldSeats.knows: what she is holding back — not that it is a seat
heldSeats.ifBeaten: the challenger who beat her may finish, and a finish is a seat

openSeats.note: nobody holds it and nobody else reaches for it — the most dangerous seat in the world
